# Sparkle Towers

> Sparkle Towers is a twin-tower residential complex on Al Sayorah Street in Dubai Marina, the two towers linked by a four-storey podium. The taller rises twenty-nine floors and its neighbour fourteen, above three basement parking levels, together holding 373 homes from studios to four-bedroom penthouses plus ten ground-floor retail units. Crystal detailing and more than 1,700 exterior lighting fixtures give the towers their jewelled appearance. Residents share an infinity pool, spa and gymnasium.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2019

## MENASCO Scope

Sparkle Towers is a twin-tower residential development in Dubai Marina, created by Tebyan Real Estate Development in collaboration with Swarovski, with crystal detailing inside and out. The towers rise 29 and 14 floors above three basement levels and contain 373 residences and ten retail units. MENASCO executed the full MEP scope, covering HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems.
